## The question

[Where do I find the documentation for writing \newcommand's ?](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/4246/where-do-i-find-the-documentation-for-writing-newcommands), asked by [Kit](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/791/kit) on TeX Stack Exchange (2010-10-18; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> At what level of the TeX system heirarchy is `\newcommand`? Where do I find documentation for these kinds of macros (e.g. `\renewcommand`, `\def`, `\parskip`, etc.)?
>
> My objective is that I will be able to take an existing package or document class and customize it to my needs.
>
> As much as possible, kindly point me to a free online resource. Bookstores here in the Philippines do not have LaTeX in their vocabulary.
:::

Try also the [not-so-short introduction to latex][1].  Section 6.1 talks about `\newcommand` et al.


  [1]: http://tobi.oetiker.ch/lshort/lshort.pdf
